author: Synthetic Generator
content:
A synthetic competing report described Super Micro Computer's initial NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 shipments as using 128 Rubin GPUs and 64 Vera CPUs in each rack.

That configuration directly contradicts the original shipment announcement, which specified 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs per rack. Both reports refer to the same initial shipments of liquid-cooled Vera Rubin NVL72 systems.

The competing account also said the racks were being delivered with direct liquid cooling and Super Micro's Data Center Building Block Solutions.

The disputed GPU and CPU counts are the point of conflict; the report does not describe a newly introduced rack variant.
headline: Super Micro starts shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks with 128 GPUs per rack
summary: Super Micro began shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks equipped with 128 Rubin GPUs and 64 Vera CPUs.
